lesson: The short position failed because it attempted to capitalize on a markdown phase during an oversold RSI condition without waiting for a confirmed Wyckoff 'Spring' or structural liquidity sweep. The system incorrectly prioritized momentum over the exhaustion of selling volume, leading to a premature entry into a potential accumulation zone.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bullish divergence on the 4H timeframe or a reclaim of the previous session low before considering any short entries in oversold conditions.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI oversold signals less during high-volume markdown phases; prioritize Wyckoff accumulation structures.
